title: Droid Tycoon Update Log - 2026
wikitext:
This is a list of all the update logs from Star Wars: Droid Tycoon in 2026 in reverse chronological order. The logs have been aggregated from multiple official sources including the offical Discord Server and FOAD's X (Twitter) account. Information regarding future content updates is listed in [[Upcoming Content]].

== v1.38 - Droid Trading ==
11/11/2026

==== v1.38.4 & v1.38.5 ====
'''Bug Fixes'''

* Fixed an issue where new players could not claim BB-8 after compleating the tutorial.
* Fixed an issue casuing controller players to get stuck on the Nova Shop screen.
* Fixed the event timer to show the correct upcoming event.

10/11/2026

==== v1.38.3 ====

* Added Trait Locks. The player can now lock their trait on a droid. The lock protects players from accidental re-rolls.
* Added new visual changes to the Nova Shop.

'''Bug Fixes'''

* Fixed BB-8's perk not working properly.
* Fixed a UI issue on the Scourgedex screen if there are too many droids to be submitted.

==== v1.38.1 & v1.38.2 ====
'''Bug Fixes'''

* Fixed some issues causing buttons on mobile devices not to work.
* Fixed an issue where some droids would not have the correct issue.
* FIxed an issue causing players to be stuck in the Scourgedex screen.
* Fixed the 'Dance with your Companion' daily quest.
* Gold Splash Trait will now properly give gold splashes.
* Players doing the the tutorial should no longer deal damage to other players.

7/11/2026

==== v1.38 ====

* Added Droid Trading. You can trade with other players above the pickaxe vendor. Each droid can only be traded once 
* Added 5 new Nova Shop perks:
** Crit Complete
** Upgrade Chip Station 2
** Upgrade Chip Station Capacity 
** Upgrade Chip Station Offline Gains
** Fusion Combine Classes
* Tutorial Chnages
** Inproved the tutorial flow and in-game progression.
** Added BB-8 as a reward after compleating the tutorial.
** New players are invincible until their first rebirth.
* Added active play rewards. Play for 15 minutes and a Nova Crate will spawn. The amount of Nova Crystals is determined by the rebirth level.
* Fusion droids now count towards droid rebirth requirements. For example: WHL-EX can be used to complete ARG's rebirth requirements.
* Fusion recipes are now displayed on the droidex.
* Improved the collision on Blueprint Storage.
* Removed the Gonk-O-Ween event shop and treats (went live at the start of the Boosted Weekend event).

'''Bug Fixes'''

* Fixed an issue causing lag spikes under certain circumstances.

== v1.37 - Scourge Boss Fight ==

==== v1.37.3 ====

* Added Scourge Fridays as a third mini event.
** Scourge Blueprints will spawn on the conveyor.
** Scourge World Missions will spawn.
** Scourge Prime will be in the world. Players can speak to him to reset their Scourgedex in exchange for 500 Nova Crystals. 
* Changed the start times for the DJ R-3X Dance Party and Mega Crate Mini Event to their original time due to Day Light Savings.

2/11/2026

==== v1.37.2 ====

* Scourge droids can now be submitted at the Scourgedex at any possible time.
* The Huyang Hologram perk now skips the initial option dialog and goes straight to Kyber Activation.

31/10/2026

==== After Scourge Boss Fight ====

* Removed all Gonk-O-Ween decorations around the map.
* Added a Gonk-O-Ween banner to the Sandcrawler.
* Removed all Gonk-O-Ween vendors.
* Removed all scourged areas.
* Removed Scourge Prime's building area.
* Removed all Scourge Prime World Missions.
* Removed the Scourge One from the sky.
* Removed the 60 treats reward from the Scourgedex.

==== v1.37.1 ====

* Improved the UI for the boss fight rewards during the Scourge Boss Fight Event.

'''Bug Fixes'''

* Fixed an issue where some players were not able to purchase the Iconic Trait of Scourge Prime.

==== Scourge Boss Fight Event ====

* Added [[Scourge Prime]] as a new Iconic Droid.

30/10/2026

==== v1.37 ====

* Crafted Scourge droids will now have a chance of becoming Flawless (same chances as Beskar).
* Luck Boost now heavily increases Epic droids from spawning.
* Iconic Traits can now be purchased with V-Bucks.
* Treats will be converted into Nova Crystals at the end of the Gonk-O-Ween Event.

== v1.36 - Scourge ==

==== v1.36.1 & v1.36.2 ====
25/10/2026

'''Bug Fixes'''

* Fixed an issue preventing players from selling Scourge droids to Scourge Prime.
* Fixed an issue preventing players from purchasing items from the Gonk-O-Ween Shop.

24/10/2026

==== Scourge Event ====

* Added Scourge blueprints.
* Added Scoruge crates.
* Added two new base paints:
** Scourge Paint
** Scourge Prime Paint
* Added the Scourge Dex.
* Added Scourge Surges and Scourge Surge Tokens to the Nova Shop and Cantina Shop.
* Removed Beskar Surges from the Nova Shop and Cantina Shop.
* Added Scourge Prime to the world.

==== v1.36 ====
* Added a new variant: Scourge.
** Scourge Droids are only available if Scourge Prime is in the map (every Friday and every day during Gonk-O-Ween).
** Scourge Droids counts for all variants for the rebirth requirements.
** Scourge Droids are available at the conveyor and through Scourge Crates.
** Scourge Crates can be unlocked after compleating a World Mission.
** The more Scoruge Droids inside the players base, the more credits incone.
* CB-23 Missions now work on splitscreen.
* The Iconic Trait is now guaranteed after 60 rolls.
* Iconic Traits now have a confirmation before rolling them.
* Gonk-O-Ween Shop Updates:
** Chopper's Costume and the Pumpkin Paint from the Punpkin Smash Event have been added.
** Added the Cosumables Tab that unlocks at the start of the Scourge Event.

== v1.35 - Droid Traits ==

==== v1.35.1 ====
20/10/2026

* Event Timer is set back to 24 hours instead of 2x 12 hours.
* Non-Iconic Traits now cost Credits instead of Nova Crystals.
* Fishing for Scrap World Mission Updates:
** The timer to complete the quicktime minigame has been increased for all stages.
** Decreased the amount of World Mission Points needed to 4 star the Fishing World Mission.
** Scourge Scrap is now worth the most amount of points.

'''Bug Fixes'''

* Fixed hotkeys breaking in cosmetic menu after playing the Fishing for Scrap World Mission.

==== After the Iconic Gonk Event: ====

* Added Scourge enemies to World Missions.
* Added Scoruge Scrap tot he Fishing World Mission.

==== v1.35 ====
18/10/2026

* Added droid traits:
** This is a second companion perk that can be purchased with Nova Crystals. Iconic Droids have exclusive traits. There are several different traits.
* Added a upper lounge area.
* Added 8 new lounge slots that can be purchased at the Nova Shop.
* World Mission Updates:
** Added a leaderbord after a World Mission that shows the top contributor.
** Changed the gameplay of Sarlacc Fishing.
** Added Kyber Surge as reward after compleating a World Mission.
* Added a list in the Workshop Paint Menu to make searching for a specific paint easier.
* Reworked Rebirth Path 6 to fit the structure of the other rebirth paths.
* CB-23 Mission Updates:
** Increased the Nova Crystals amount obtained from CB-23 mission from 4 > 40.
** Increased the Upgrade Chips amount obtained from CB-23 mission.
* Added new flags near the arena.
* The purple ship in the sky is a bit closer.
* Iconic Gonk Event changes:
** The sandcrawler conveyor now has the regular spawn rate during the Gonk Army Conveyor Boost.
** Gonk and Power Droids placed in the lounge can be all turned in after speaking to WG-22.

=== Gonk-O-Ween Event ===

* Start of the [[Events|Gonk-O-Ween Event]].

** Huyang Hologram

* Added the Huyang Bundle to the Cantina Shop.

29/7/2026
